## File: facebookresearch_foundpose/external/dinov2/dinov2/models/vision_transformer.py

Prompts

```
['build a DINOv2 ViT-Small vision transformer model with 384 embedding dim and 12 layers', 'build a DINOv2 ViT-Base vision transformer model with 768 embedding dim and 12 layers', 'build a DINOv2 ViT-Large vision transformer model with 1024 embedding dim and 24 layers', 'run forward_features on a DinoVisionTransformer to extract cls, register, and patch token embeddings', 'extract intermediate layer outputs from a DinoVisionTransformer with optional reshaping and normalization']
```

Usage

```
{'build_vit_small_model': 'build a DINOv2 ViT-Small vision transformer model with 384 embedding dim and 12 layers', 'build_vit_base_model': 'build a DINOv2 ViT-Base vision transformer model with 768 embedding dim and 12 layers', 'build_vit_large_model': 'build a DINOv2 ViT-Large vision transformer model with 1024 embedding dim and 24 layers', 'run_forward_features': 'run forward_features on a DinoVisionTransformer to extract cls, register, and patch token embeddings', 'extract_intermediate_layers': 'extract intermediate layer outputs from a DinoVisionTransformer with optional reshaping and normalization'}
```
